notes: Values are display values (sppro/settings_meta.json scaling); enums compare labels.
{N} in a rule expands to the eight Solar Hybrid priorities (SystemSchedule1..8).
'active(N)' = SystemScheduleNEnable is Enabled or SystemScheduleNDigitalInput is not None (SP LINK's test for a priority in use).
severity: error = SP LINK refuses to save; warning = SP LINK warns. confidence: high = read directly; check = constant or operand to confirm.

send_checks use the unit's live state as well as the configuration: unit.output_mode (Output Mode, 0xa07d), unit.hardware_revision, unit.comms_card_revision, unit.region (as configured now), unit.factory_export_limit, link.port (the SP PRO port selpi is talking through: low byte of 0xa000). 'changed(X)' = the write changes setting X.

models: per SP PRO model (SP LINK's list): battery cells (DC voltages are stored per cell), nominal V, and the minimum battery size for AC-coupled systems. 'model' = the unit's model (selpi reads it from the unit).

rules.message: Low battery to start generator (no load) must be higher or equal to the full load level.
Low SoC generator start: Stop SoC must be at least 1 % higher than Start SoC.
Normal period: Stop SoC must be at least 1 % higher than Start SoC.
Night assist period: Stop SoC must be at least 1 % higher than Start SoC.
Renewable preferred period: Stop SoC must be at least 1 % higher than Start SoC.
Renewable assist period: Stop SoC must be at least 1 % higher than Start SoC.
Priority {N}: AC source disconnect and inverter lockout are both enabled, which is not a valid configuration.
Priority {N}: minimum SoC to support load must be at least 2 % above the SoC shutdown level.
Priority {N}: SoC start charging must be at least 2 % above the SoC shutdown level.
Priority {N}: SoC start charging must be at or below SoC stop charging.
Low DC shutdown at 0 % load must be greater or equal to the 100 % load level.
High DC alert clear should be between the absolute voltage limit and the high DC alert level.

rules.require: max(InitialChargeV, BulkChargeV, AbsorbChargeV, FloatV, FloatReturn, EqualiseV, AbsoluteVoltageLimit) <= 162
rules.message: Charge voltages and the absolute voltage limit should not exceed 162 V.

rules.when: is_managed_bms(BatteryType) and BatteryType not in ('BMS - Cegasa/SelectCell 144V', 'BMS - ZYC')
rules.message: Battery type is only available for 48 V models.

rules.when: KacoModeCommPort in ('ABB Solar on Port 1', 'ABB / FIMER')
rules.message: With an ABB / FIMER solar inverter, the 0 % AC coupled output must be Digital Control Output 3 (check it isn't used by another control).
Region must be set when Application type is Solar Hybrid (AS4777.2:2020).
AC source disconnect in a priority is not recommended when generic AC coupling is enabled.
{value} is used by more than one function ({settings}); SP LINK allows one function per input.
{value} is used by more than one function ({settings}); SP LINK allows one function per output.

rules.require: BatterySize >= (models[model].min_ah_lead_acid if BatteryType in ('Lead Acid Sealed', 'Lead Acid Flooded') else models[model].min_ah_lithium_custom if BatteryType in ('Lithium LiFePO4', 'Custom', 'Lithium genZ') else 0)
rules.message: For AC coupled systems, Battery Size needs to be at least {min} Ah for this model and battery type.
rules.note: BMS battery types are not checked (SP LINK checks only lead acid, LiFePO4, custom, genZ; batteryless = 0)

rules.message: Priority {N}: AC input and export capacities are set too close to each other (they should be at least 0 kW apart).
rules.note: SP LINK's GetACSourceDifferenceInkW: input - (0 - export), both in kW (A x 240 / 1000, kVA x 0.8); both are stored >= 0, so this only catches an invalid negative value

rules.require: InitialReturnVoltage <= min(FloatV, FloatReturn) * (0.98 if BatteryType in ('Lithium LiFePO4', 'Lithium genZ', 'Custom', 'Lithium PowerPlus', 'BMS - Cegasa 48V', 'BMS - Cegasa/SelectCell 144V') else 0.95)
rules.message: Initial Return Voltage is close to the Float / Float Return voltage (SP LINK shows it in the warning colour).

rules.when: KacoModeCommPort is not None and 'Powador' in KacoModeCommPort
rules.message: The string-inverter port cannot be a Powador mode when Powerchain Inverters per Phase is greater than 1.

not_yet: AS4777.2:2020 not available on some models (model list)
multi-phase structure / count must match the detected inverters (multi-phase sites only)
String Inverter model not supported by the SP PRO firmware (firmware-version gated, like the Inhibit* checks)

factory export limit (export_pretrip_above_factory_limit send-check): SP LINK reads it at connect via its protocol dispatch (deci-units, 0xFFFF=blank, next to the factory Kaco mode); the register is not identifiable from static IL or our selpi captures. Pin it at the 3 Dec hardware session (full SP LINK connect through the mitm proxy, or probe candidate factory registers). Until then the check self-gates (inert on non-export-limited units), so leaving it produces no wrong results.

send_checks.message: Cannot change Nominal Frequency unless the inverter's output mode is Idle.
The SP PRO is already configured for Solar Hybrid (AS4777.2:2020) with a region; changing it needs the installer-only code (selpi refuses).

send_checks.require: int(Port1Baudrate) <= 57600 and int(Port2Baudrate) <= 57600 and 'Auto' not in (Port1Baudrate, Port2Baudrate)
send_checks.message: This inverter cannot communicate at rates higher than 57600 baud.

send_checks.require: KacoModeCommPort not in ('RS232 Port 1 Powador', 'RS232 Port 2 Powador')
send_checks.message: The firmware in the SP PRO no longer supports RS232 mode.
The inverter needs the Comms Card 2017 for this battery type.

send_checks.when: ApplicationType in ('Solar Hybrid (On Grid)', 'Solar Hybrid (AS4777.2:2020)') and unit.factory_export_limit
send_checks.message: This inverter is export limited; the export pre-trip power limit must be set above that limit.

send_checks.when: ApplicationType in ('Solar Hybrid (On Grid)', 'Solar Hybrid (AS4777.2:2020)') and KacoExportPreTripDirection == 'Export'
send_checks.message: The export pre-trip power limit must be above the highest export limit of the active priorities.

send_checks.require: not ((KacoModeCommPort in ('RS232 Port 1 Powador', 'RS485 Port 1 Powador') and link.port == 1) or (KacoModeCommPort == 'RS232 Port 2 Powador' and link.port == 2) or (KacoModeCommPort not in ('Disabled', 'RS232 Port 1 Powador', 'RS232 Port 2 Powador', 'RS485 Port 1 Powador') and link.port == 2 and not unit.comms_card_attached) or (changed(Port1AccInput) and link.port == 1 and unit.comms_card_attached))
send_checks.message: This configuration reassigns the SP PRO / comms card port selpi is connected through: communication may be lost.
send_checks.note: SP LINK: KacoModeCommPort 1 / 3 use SP PRO port 1, 2 uses port 2, 4+ use port 2 without a comms card; the comms card accessory port (0xc087) reassigns port 1 on log out
